title: Ford’s new AI assistant will help fleet owners know if seatbelts are being used
description: Ford Pro AI debuted at Work Truck Week in Indianapolis and is now available to all of its U.S.-based Pro telematics subscribers.
author: Kirsten Korosec

title: Zendesk acquires agentic customer service startup Forethought
description: Forethought was years ahead of its time and the 2018 winner of TechCrunch Battlefield.
author: Julie Bort

title: Netflix may have paid $600 million for Ben Affleck’s AI startup
description: This deal could rank as among the streaming giant's largest acquisitions ever.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Lovable says it added $100M in revenue last month alone, with just 146 employees
description: Swedish vibe-coding unicorn Lovable crossed $400 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR) in February.
author: Anna Heim

title: Replit snags $9B valuation 6 months after hitting $3B
description: Replit raised a new $400 million round and said it hopes to have $1B in ARR by year's end.
author: Julie Bort

title: WordPress debuts a private workspace that runs in your browser via a new service, my.WordPress.net
description: WordPress’s new browser-based service lets users create private sites without hosting or signing up, turning the platform into a personal workspace for writing, research, and AI tools.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Rivian spin-out Mind Robotics raises $500M for industrial AI-powered robots
description: The startup, which was created by Rivian founder RJ Scaringe, is looking to train on data from, and deploy in, Rivian's factory.
author: Sean O'Kane

title: Meta’s Moltbook deal points to a future built around AI agents
description: Meta’s Moltbook acquisition may look odd at first, but the deal could signal how Meta sees AI agents shaping future advertising and commerce on an agentic web.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Amazon expands a program that lets customers shop from other retailers’ sites
description: The changes allow more merchants to participate in Amazon's Shop Direct program, which sends Amazon customers to other retailers' websites.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Canopii looks to succeed where past indoor farms have not
description: Canopii's robotic farms can autonomously grow 40,000 pounds of herbs and leafy greens a year while being the size of a basketball court.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Google brings Gemini in Chrome to India
description: As part of the rollout, Gemini will support languages including Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Telugu, and Tamil.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Amazon launches its healthcare AI assistant on its website and app
description: Health AI can answer questions, explain health records, manage prescription renewals, book appointments, and more.
author: Aisha Malik

title: AI-powered apps struggle with long-term retention, new report shows
description:
AI can drive stronger early
monetization for apps, but sustaining value remains the challenge, RevenueCat's latest report finds.
author: Sarah Perez

title: ChatGPT can now create interactive visuals to help you understand math and science concepts
description: Instead of just reading an explanation or looking at a static diagram, users can now engage directly with interactive visuals.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: AgentMail raises $6M to build an email service for AI agents
description: AgentMail provides an API platform that lets you give AI agents their own email inboxes, with support for two-way conversations, parsing, threading, labeling, searching, and replying.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Thinking Machines Lab inks massive compute deal with Nvidia
description: The multi-year deal involves at least a gigawatt of compute power and also includes a strategic investment from Nvidia.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Google gives in to users’ complaints over AI-powered ‘Ask Photos’ search feature
description: The option appears on the Google Photos Search screen and lets users pick which experience they want.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Legora reaches $5.55 billion valuation as AI legaltech boom endures
description: Legora, an AI platform for lawyers, is now valued at $5.55 billion following a $550 million Series D led by Accel to fuel its growth in the U.S.
author: Anna Heim

title: Meta acquired Moltbook, the AI agent social network that went viral because of fake posts
description: Meta says that Moltbook's approach to "connecting agents through an always-on-directory" is novel.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: YouTube expands AI deepfake detection to politicians, government officials, and journalists
description: YouTube's AI deepfake detection tool is becoming available to politicians, journalists, and officials, letting them flag unauthorized likenesses for removal.
author: Sarah Perez

title: YouTube expands AI deepfake detection for politicians, government officials, and journalists

author: Sarah Perez

title: Adobe is debuting an AI assistant for Photoshop
description: Adobe is also adding new AI-powered image editing features to Firefly.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Google rolls out new Gemini capabilities to Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive
description: The idea behind the new features is to make the apps more personal and capable to help users get things done faster, right within the platforms themselves.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Zoom introduces an AI-powered office suite, says AI avatars for meetings arrive this month
description: Zoom is also introducing a real-time deepfake detection tech for meetings
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Sandbar secures $23M Series A for its AI note-taking ring
description: Sandbar aims to ship the Stream, which can be used to take notes, chat with an AI assistant, and for media playback, this summer.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Yann LeCun’s AMI Labs raises $1.03 billion to build world models
description: AMI Labs, the new venture cofounded by Turing Prize winner Yann LeCun after he left Meta, has raised $1.03 billion at a $3.5 billion pre-money valuation.
author: Anna Heim

title: OpenAI and Google employees rush to Anthropic’s defense in DOD lawsuit
description: More than 30 OpenAI and Google DeepMind employees signed onto a statement supporting Anthropic's lawsuit against the Defense Department after the agency labeled the AI firm a supply-chain risk, according to court filings.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Anthropic launches code review tool to check flood of AI-generated code
description: Anthropic launched Code Review in Claude Code, a multi-agent system that automatically analyzes AI-generated code, flags logic errors, and helps enterprise developers manage the growing volume of code produced with AI.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: OpenAI acquires Promptfoo to secure its AI agents
description: This deal underscores how frontier labs are scrambling to prove their technology can be used safely in critical business operations.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Anthropic sues Defense Department over supply-chain risk designation
description: Anthropic filed suit against the Department of Defense on Monday after the agency labeled it a supply chain risk. The complaint calls the DOD's actions "unprecedented and unlawful."
author: Rebecca Bellan
